scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:auth: cd services/auth && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.dev:files: cd services/files && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8002
scripts.dev:integrations: cd services/integrations && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8003
scripts.dev:ai-support: cd packages/ai-services/ai-support-service && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8004
scripts.dev:voice: cd packages/ai-services/voice-service && poetry run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8005
scripts.install:both: npm run install:js && npm run install:python
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:python
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: poetry run black --check . && poetry run isort --check-only . && poetry run flake8 . && poetry run mypy .
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:python
scripts.format:python: poetry run black . && poetry run isort .
